steps.title: Initialize App Specifications
steps.description: Establish basic project structure, identifying package 'com.tinyapp.app' and app name 'Tiny App' as requested.

steps.title: Define Gradle Build Configurations
steps.description: Configure build.gradle to ensure full compatibility with Gradle 8.5, Java 17, and AGP 8.3.2 without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest Entry
steps.description: Define AndroidManifest.xml configuration including standard launcher activity, standard light system theme, and package configurations.

steps.title: Design Minimalist Layout
steps.description: Build an incredibly light, beautiful single-page XML layout utilizing lightweight layout containers, simple count displays, and active roll counters.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Develop core Java logic in MainActivity.java to support interactive tap counting and randomized dice rolling under Java 8 compliance.

steps.title: Configure Click Handlers
steps.description: Establish button listeners inside MainActivity.java utilizing classic anonymous inner classes for optimum performance and legacy compatibility.

steps.title: Integrate Basic Math Operations
steps.description: Establish random bounds generator for the tiny app's decider/dice functionality and boundary validation for the digital counter.

steps.title: Verify Code Cleanliness
steps.description: Validate that there are zero external library imports or unsupported AndroidX dependencies within the classes.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Namespaces
steps.description: Confirm that Android schema declarations point exclusively to authentic Android SDK namespaces.

steps.title: Building Tiny App
steps.description: Compile the entire project into a cohesive debug APK using the predefined pipeline.
